content.lead: A general inquiry should not request SSNs, bank statements, sensitive financial identifiers or confidential partner credentials.

sections.heading: THE REALITY
sections.body: A general inquiry should not request SSNs, bank statements, sensitive financial identifiers or confidential partner credentials.

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: Use the published administrative contact address for ordinary questions. Redirect financing and partner requests to their separate workflows.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
sections.body: Start with a short description of the subject and the relevant page or service, if applicable. Keep this channel limited to ordinary business correspondence, and use the dedicated application or partner intake when a request concerns sensitive financial details.

complianceNotes: Editorial draft; no invented financial product terms.
